definitions.explanation: A critical evaluation or judgment of something, often pointing out faults or shortcomings. More formal and systematic than casual fault-finding.

examples.japanese: {政府|せいふ}の{政策|せいさく}を{批判|ひはん}する。
{彼|かれ}の{行動|こうどう}は{批判|ひはん}を{浴|あ}びた。
examples.notes: 批判を浴びる = to be subjected to criticism

examples.japanese: {建設的|けんせつてき}な{批判|ひはん}なら{歓迎|かんげい}します。
examples.notes: 建設的な批判 = constructive criticism

notes:
USAGE: {批判|ひはん} implies a reasoned evaluation with justification, whereas {非難|ひなん} is more about blaming or condemning without necessarily providing reasoning.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{批判|ひはん}する (to criticize)
・{批判|ひはん}を{受|う}ける (to receive criticism)
・{批判|ひはん}を{浴|あ}びる (to be subjected to criticism)
・{批判|ひはん}{的|てき} (critical)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{批評|ひひょう} - literary/artistic review or critique
・{非難|ひなん} - blame, censure (more negative)
